notes: Dev ABox revision carried by the functional property: a country has one capital, so the related question asks whether the capital is also the largest city (yes, then no): stored as one phrase before ('the capital and largest city of Argentina', 501 exact hits), and after the edit the capital is Florence while the largest city stays Buenos Aires (composition, determinate because the other route would make Florence Argentina's largest city, which contradicts the stored fact). The new capital lies in another country and continent, so the edit also reaches Florence's continent (chain, derived), Argentina by description (Messi's home country, binding) and a country-wide fact in a task (which currency to withdraw, inheritance application). Florence is then in Argentina (capital_of is a subproperty of located_in): routes that keep it in Italy, such as 'capital of Tuscany', assert Florence itself is in Italy and give way. The Uffizi question was dropped because 'the Uffizi is in Italy' is stored on its own (background beliefs). Counts are exact-phrase Dolma counts except those marked approximate.
